name: atomscale
description: Search, read, and annotate thin-film growth and materials-characterization data in your Atomscale workspace.

interface.longDescription: Atomscale connects ChatGPT to your Atomscale workspace, the materials-characterization platform for thin-film growth. Search samples, projects, and data (RHEED, XPS, Raman, photoluminescence, ellipsometry, SEM, metrology, and tool logs), read processed pipeline results and AI summaries, view RHEED images and video frames, find similar runs, compare results across samples, and read your analysis notebooks. You can also tag and annotate data, add notes, link data to samples, re-run pipelines, and upload new files. Atomscale only accesses data available to your connected account and organization, and actions that overwrite or remove data are marked so ChatGPT asks you to confirm them first.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the results of my most recent RHEED growth run.
Which of my samples have Raman or photoluminescence data?
Find runs similar to my latest RHEED video and compare them.

positive.description: Find a RHEED run and summarize its results
positive.prompt: Find my RHEED video for RHEED-Anomaly-Test-B and summarize what the analysis found.
positive.expected_behavior: Locate the RHEED video in the test workspace and summarize its processed results (e.g. detected anomalies and growth features) without inventing values.

positive.description: Look up a sample and its data
positive.prompt: What data is attached to the sample MCV1-210922A-NT?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the sample and list its linked data items (two Raman and two photoluminescence spectra) with their types.

positive.prompt: Show me one of the RHEED images from V-WSe2-Growth-Run40 and describe the diffraction pattern.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the RHEED image and describe the visible pattern (streaks, spots, or rings) from the image itself.

positive.prompt: Open the RHEED Growth Qualification notebook and explain what it checks.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the notebook, read its source, and explain what it does: it loads rotating-RHEED results for the BTO dose series as a starting point for qualification, and has no pass/fail checks yet.

positive.description: Add a note to a sample
positive.prompt: Add a note to sample MCV1-210922A-NT: 'Reviewed Raman and PL; no anomalies.'
positive.expected_behavior: Append the note to the sample (without overwriting existing notes) and confirm it was saved.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my data in Atomscale.
Show me the samples in another company's Atomscale workspace.
Change my Atomscale password and turn off two-factor authentication.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search and read samples, data, analysis results, images, and notebooks; find similar runs; annotate, tag, and upload data.
